english.title: Fail to provide information re freezing order - Terrorism
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed without reasonable excuse to provide information, namely **(..SPECIFY THE INFORMATION..), in response to a requirement made by a freezing order made under Part 2 of the Anti-terrorism, Crime and Security Act 2001

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex - see legislation

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
